budget_items.topic: 430 Mulpus Road storm water performance guarantee account
budget_items.what_was_said: Restructuring an over-a-year-old performance guarantee deposit account required monetary amounts and account-holder names from the building inspector before the paperwork could be finalized, so that piece was deferred. The board proceeded anyway to vote motions to close the old account and move funds to a new one, planning to complete paperwork once figures arrive.

The storm water task force described a system based on equivalent residential units (ERU) that would charge every property, including commercial and institutional, according to its impervious area impact, intended to create a dedicated funding stream, staff and equipment for storm water work rather than relying on ad hoc DPW capacity. No dollar figures were given; the task force hopes to present something at the next town meeting.

minutes.headline: Planning Board approved a scaled-down 260 Fula Road warehouse; continued Northfield Road driveway hearing to August.
minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Planning Board closed the hearing on 260 Fula Road and approved a modified, smaller warehouse site plan and storm water permit with peer-review conditions, while continuing the 1083 Northfield Road common-driveway/storm water hearing to August 25 amid quorum concerns. The board also voted to restructure an outdated storm water performance guarantee account for 430 Mulpus Road, heard committee updates including an ERU-based storm water enterprise fund proposal, and set a process for signing an outstanding decision (443/West Townsend Road) outside of a formal meeting.

what_happened.line: The board closed the hearing and approved a scaled-down warehouse site plan and stormwater permit for 260 Fula Road, subject to conditions including a clean peer-review letter.
The Northfield Road hearing on a common driveway and stormwater permit was continued to August 25 amid concern the board lacked a full quorum able to vote.
The board voted to close an outdated stormwater guarantee account for 430 Mulpus Road and move the funds into a new one, with paperwork pending figures from the building inspector.
A town stormwater task force described a proposed fund that would charge every property, including commercial and institutional, based on its impervious surface area.
The board set a process to sign the outstanding West Townsend Road decision by email review and in-person signature rather than at a formal meeting.

why_it_matters: The Fula Road decision clears a warehouse project, reduced from its original size, to proceed with peer-reviewed stormwater conditions attached.
The Northfield Road continuance affects a pending common-driveway and stormwater permit; neighbors of that project wait until at least August 25 for a vote.
The stormwater task force's fund idea, if it reaches town meeting, would be a new charge tied to a property's paved and roofed area, applying to homes and businesses alike.
watch_next: Continued Northfield Road hearing at the August 25, 2025 Planning Board meeting
Stormwater task force's ERU-based fund proposal, expected at an upcoming town meeting
